nodes.title: Note: MiniMax H3
widgets_values:
## MiniMax H3

[MiniMax H3](https://www.minimax.io/blog/minimax-h3) is MiniMax's general-purpose, omni-modal generation model. It jointly understands text, image, video, and audio, and generates video with **native stereo audio**: voice, sound effects, and music are modeled jointly in a single forward pass, not layered on afterward. Output is up to 2K resolution, 24fps, and up to about 15 seconds.

## ComfyUI links
- [ComfyUI#15224](https://github.com/Comfy-Org/ComfyUI/pull/15224)
- [🤗 Comfy-Org/MiniMax-H3](https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/MiniMax-H3)

## About this workflow

This template runs the **reference-to-video (ref2va)** task using the `MiniMaxH3ReferenceToVideo` node. It takes any mix of reference images, videos, and standalone audio, and weaves them into the generation to lock in a character's identity, a style, a motion, a camera move, or a voice.

**Key inputs**

- **ref_images / ref_videos / ref_video_audios / ref_audios**: up to 9 reference images, 3 reference videos (each may carry its own paired soundtrack), and 3 standalone reference audio clips
- **prompt**: reference the inputs by tag, in the exact order they were connected, for example `<Picture 1>`, `<Video 1>`, `<Audio 1>`, then describe the target scene, motion, and audio
- **ref_image_size**: `match` scales references down to the generation's resolution (faster); `max` keeps up to a 2048px short edge for stronger identity fidelity, at the cost of speed since reference tokens ride along every sampling step
- **width / height**: set via Resolution Selector.
- **duration (seconds)**: converted to a valid frame `length` by the Math Expression node

**Sampling and decode**

- Sampler: `res_multistep`. `beta` or `normal` scheduler tends to outperform `simple` for reference-heavy prompts like this one
- The sampler's joint audio+video `LATENT` output feeds directly into both `VAEDecode` (video, `minimax_h3_video_vae_fp16`) and `VAEDecodeAudio` (audio, `minimax_h3_audio_vae_fp32`); each decode node automatically pulls its own half out of the packed latent. `CreateVideo` then muxes the two into a single MP4 with synced sound
- The diffusion model here is `minimax_h3_ref2va_pruned_int8_convrot.safetensors`, a different set of weights from the `fl2va` model used by the t2v/i2v templates

Ref2va's output is very sensitive to prompt wording; matching the reference tags precisely and being explicit about which reference drives which part of the shot tends to work best.

## Model Links
[🤗 Comfy-Org/MiniMax-H3](https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/MiniMax-H3)

**vae**

- [minimax_h3_video_vae_fp16.safetensors](https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/MiniMax-H3/resolve/main/vae/minimax_h3_video_vae_fp16.safetensors)
- [minimax_h3_audio_vae_fp32.safetensors](https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/MiniMax-H3/resolve/main/vae/minimax_h3_audio_vae_fp32.safetensors)

**diffusion_models**

- [minimax_h3_ref2va_pruned_int8_convrot.safetensors](https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/MiniMax-H3/resolve/main/diffusion_models/minimax_h3_ref2va_pruned_int8_convrot.safetensors)

**text_encoders**

- [qwen3vl_32b_minimax_h3_nvfp4_awq.safetensors](https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/MiniMax-H3/resolve/main/text_encoders/qwen3vl_32b_minimax_h3_nvfp4_awq.safetensors)

**loras**

- 4 steps: [minimax_h3_ref2v_turbo_4step_v0.1_comfyui_bf16.safetensors](https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/MiniMax-H3/resolve/main/loras/minimax_h3_ref2v_turbo_4step_v0.1_comfyui_bf16.safetensors)

**embeddings**

- [10 style embeddings](https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/MiniMax-H3/tree/main/embeddings) (`minimaxh3_*.safetensors`), for example `minimaxh3_art_is_explosion`

## Model Storage Location

```
📂 ComfyUI/
├── 📂 models/
│   ├── 📂 vae/
│   │   ├── minimax_h3_video_vae_fp16.safetensors
│   │   └── minimax_h3_audio_vae_fp32.safetensors
│   ├── 📂 diffusion_models/
│   │   └── minimax_h3_ref2va_pruned_int8_convrot.safetensors
│   ├── 📂 text_encoders/
│   │   └── qwen3vl_32b_minimax_h3_nvfp4_awq.safetensors
│   ├── 📂 loras/
│   │   └── minimax_h3_ref2v_turbo_4step_v0.1_comfyui_bf16.safetensors
│   └── 📂 embeddings/
│       └── minimaxh3_art_is_explosion.safetensors
```

## Using Prompt Embeddings

Prompt embeddings (supported since [ComfyUI#15697](https://github.com/Comfy-Org/ComfyUI/pull/15697)) add reusable style tokens to your prompt. Download one or more embeddings from the folder above into `ComfyUI/models/embeddings/`, then reference one in the prompt text with the `embedding:` prefix and the filename without its extension, for example:

`embedding:minimaxh3_art_is_explosion`

Using an embedding is optional and the template runs fine without one.

## Report Issue

Note: Please update ComfyUI first ([guide](https://docs.comfy.org/installation/update_comfyui)) and prepare required models. Desktop/Cloud updates follow stable releases, so some nightly-supported models may not be available yet.

- Cannot run / runtime errors: [ComfyUI/issues](https://github.com/comfyanonymous/ComfyUI/issues)
- UI / frontend issues: [ComfyUI_frontend/issues](https://github.com/Comfy-Org/ComfyUI_frontend/issues)
- Workflow issues: [workflow_templates/issues](https://github.com/Comfy-Org/workflow_templates/issues)

subject_definitions:
<Subject 1> is the Quorum manifestation continued from <Video 1>: an uncannily tall hooded feline-hominid figure with layered black ceremonial robes, recessed feline face, dark metallic collars, and circular pendants. Preserve the cyan-lit close portrait state established at the end of <Video 1>.

<Subject 2> is the Orrery mechanism defined by <Picture 1> and continued from <Video 1>, especially the polished black central globe with fine gold veining, damp reflective surface, and broad brass orbital ring structure.

<Subject 3> is the stormbound henge environment continued from <Video 1>, including rain, cyan-blue planetary spill light, wet dark stone, and subdued Highland storm atmosphere.

<Subject 4> is the reflected visual influence of the intact Quorum homeworld defined by <Picture 2>. In the target clip, preserve only its cyan-violet atmospheric character and broad luminous reflection behavior as seen across the curved surface of <Subject 2>. Do not present <Subject 2> as the actual planet.

<Video 1> is the immediate continuation source for the target video. It provides the closing Quorum portrait after Riot’s line “Your... world?” and the Quorum’s reply “Once.”, along with the storm ambience and cyan planetary illumination.

<Video 2> is the destination-reference source for the following RKV sequence. It provides the opening intact-planet visual logic, tonal register, and the first-stage deep-space audiovisual character that the target clip should prepare.

<Audio 1> is the synchronized audio track of <Video 1>, referenced for continuity of the Quorum’s whisper tail, Highland rain, wind, low atmospheric pressure, and restrained Orrery ambience.

<Audio 2> is the synchronized audio track of <Video 2>, referenced for the onset character of the following RKV sequence’s planetary-space sound field without directly copying the signal.

summary:
[video continuation + reference generation + audio reference] The target video continues directly from <Video 1>, briefly holding on the Quorum after “Once.” It then cuts to an extreme close-up of <Subject 2>, the Orrery’s polished black globe, where cyan reflected light from <Subject 4> plays across the wet curved surface. A brass orbital ring sweeps across the frame until it creates full visual occlusion, ending the clip on a deliberate dark mechanical wipe that prepares a natural hard cut into <Video 2>.

retention_analysis:
<Subject 1> (appears in [Shot 1]): fully_preserved - preserve the Quorum’s hooded close-portrait state, cyan-blue edge light, stillness, and solemn presence from the end of <Video 1>.

<Subject 2> (appears in [Shot 2] and [Shot 3]): fully_preserved - preserve the Orrery’s polished black globe, fine gold veining, brass ring geometry, and coherent mechanical identity.

<Subject 3> (appears throughout): fully_preserved - preserve the wet storm atmosphere, rain-softened cyan illumination, and restrained physical environment.

<Subject 4> (appears as reflected influence in [Shot 2] and [Shot 3]): partially_preserved - preserve only its cyan-violet luminous reflection character and atmospheric suggestion on the globe surface, not a literal direct planet view.

<Video 1> (opening continuation and emotional state): fully_preserved - continue directly from its final Quorum portrait and its immediate audiovisual aftermath.

<Video 2> (destination visual and audio logic): weak_reference - use it to shape the transition target and the final occlusion handoff into the following intact-planet RKV shot.

<Audio 1>: reference - continue the Quorum whisper decay, rain, wind, and storm-pressure character from <Audio 1> without directly copying the source signal.

<Audio 2>: reference - foreshadow the onset of the following RKV sequence’s planetary-space ambience and low-frequency pressure without directly copying the source signal.

detailed_description:
The target video uses restrained photorealistic science-fiction cinematography, precise editorial structure, macro mechanical detail, realistic wet materials, and tightly synchronized environmental sound. Generate a 3.0-second clip.

[Shot 1] Continue directly from <Video 1> for approximately 0.700 seconds. Hold on <Subject 1> in close portrait, framed from the upper chest upward. The Quorum remains almost perfectly still inside the deep hood. Cyan-blue planetary light traces the hood edge, muzzle, and metal ornaments. The word “Once.” has just been spoken. No new dialogue occurs. The layered whisper tail decays inward. High-frequency rain and wind soften slightly. After a brief beat, <Subject 1> shifts its gaze subtly past Riot toward the Orrery without moving its body.

[Shot 2] At 00:00.700, cut to an extreme close-up of <Subject 2>, the Orrery’s polished black central globe, filling most of the frame. Use a 100mm to 120mm macro-style lens impression. The globe is clearly a dark polished mechanical sphere rather than the literal planet. Preserve fine gold veining, wet reflective texture, and a fragment of the brass mounting structure. Cyan-violet reflected illumination from <Subject 4> glides abstractly across the globe’s curved surface, suggesting the homeworld’s atmospheric rim and luminous weather without fully resolving into a direct planetary image.

The background is mostly dark and soft, with only faint hints of the wet henge and surrounding mechanism. Rain beads cling to the globe surface. The camera remains locked.

[Shot 3] At 00:01.600, a broad brass orbital ring of <Subject 2> passes very close across the foreground from one side of frame to the other in a slow, smooth, mechanically driven sweep. As it crosses, it progressively covers the globe and compresses the cyan reflected light into a narrowing curved edge. The metallic ring fills more and more of the screen until it fully occludes the image for the final 0.250 to 0.350 seconds of the clip. End during full near-black occlusion created by the underside of the ring, not on the globe itself.

overall_soundscape:
At the opening, continue the decaying whisper aftermath, softened Highland rain, distant wind, and low atmospheric pressure referenced from <Audio 1>. As the video cuts to the Orrery globe, shift the sound focus downward and inward: introduce quiet gear engagement, restrained brass bearing friction, and a subtle mechanical rotational sweep that tracks the motion of the orbital ring across the stereo field. The rain becomes more muted and low-pass filtered while the machine occupies the acoustic foreground. Beneath the mechanism, sustain a deep non-rhythmic pressure bed that gradually transitions toward the planetary-space character referenced from <Audio 2>. During the final full occlusion, reduce close rain almost completely, retain deep pressure and metallic resonance, and make the ending feel like an intentional handoff into the next clip.

N/A
